subject: VM evidence: scan cadence, SLA commitment & CVE closure rotation
messages:
From: Anita Patel <anita.patel@acmecorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM evidence and SLA commitments for SOC 2 review

Hi Karthik,

Quick one — Acme's audit team is preparing our SOC 2 re-assessment and the auditor has asked for updated vulnerability management evidence (scan cadence, SLA matrix, and CVE remediation attestations). Can you confirm:

- Current authenticated/unauthenticated scan cadence for prod (weekly/monthly)?
- SLAs for triage and patching by severity (critical/high/medium) — we need official commitments to include in the audit packet.
- A sample closure log or CSV showing a recent CVE-to-closure path for one critical and one high finding.

We'd like to include Redwood's answers in the audit binder by next Friday (2028-09-08). If you can attach whatever you can share (scan matrix, remediation csv, QA answers for SIG/SOC2) that would help.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation and ETA.

Best,
Anita Patel
Security Program Manager, AcmeCorp
Anita.Patel@acmecorp.com

--
AcmeCorp (external)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anita Patel <anita.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 11:03:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence and SLA commitments for SOC 2 review

Anita — thanks for the heads-up. We can provide a compact packet suitable for the SOC 2 binder. High-level commitments below; attachments are included in this thread (scan matrix + example CSV + SIG/SOC2 QA doc).

Summary commit (production):
- Scans: weekly authenticated scans across all production services; daily quick surface scans for public endpoints; quarterly full-asset authenticated scans for infra.
- Triage SLA (initial response): Critical = 48 hours; High = 72 hours; Medium = 7 business days.
- Remediation SLA (target closure): Critical = 14 calendar days from triage (accelerated hotpatching as needed); High = 30 calendar days; Medium = 90 calendar days. Exceptions documented case-by-case with compensating controls.

Evidence provided (attached):
- redwood-vm-scan-matrix-202808.pdf (scan cadence + scope matrix)
- cve-closure-log-202808.csv (redacted example showing triage -> patch -> deploy for sample critical & high items)
- soc2-sig-qa-answers.docx (answer set tailored to SIG/CAP/CAIQ VM questions)

Next steps / asks from you:
- Confirm auditor's preferred format for the CSV (we can export a CSV or a signed PDF).
- If you need an explicit attestation letter on company letterhead, we'll route that through legal — allow 48 hours.

I'm copying Laura (security) and Ben (engineering) to confirm the SLAs and that the CSV is production-sourced and redaction-safe. If helpful we can do a 20-min call tomorrow to walk through the packet.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive — Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-vm-scan-matrix-202808.pdf; cve-closure-log-202808.csv; soc2-sig-qa-answers.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anita Patel <anita.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 09:18:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence and SLA commitments for SOC 2 review

Anita — quick operational clarifications from security/ops side:

- The sample CSV is exported from our remediation tracker with columns: finding_id, cvss, severity, first_reported, triage_date, patch_submitted, deploy_date, closure_notes. We've redacted internal IPs and customer identifiers.
- Exceptions: for legacy infra components where patching requires coordinated custodial windows, we log an exception with compensating controls (WAF rules / isolation). Those exceptions are included inline in the CSV where present.
- Chain of custody: each closure row includes the engineer owner and deployment ticket ID for audit traceability.

Ben, please confirm that the sample critical (CVE-2028-1450) in the CSV shows the hotpatch and rollback test entries — Anita may request evidence of the rollout.

Anita — if you want, Ben and I can join the call Karthik suggested to run the auditor through the CSV row for the critical item.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Security Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anita Patel <anita.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Sep 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence and SLA commitments for SOC 2 review

Anita — following up and closing the loop. Per our earlier note, attached are the three items for your binder (redwood-vm-scan-matrix-202808.pdf, cve-closure-log-202808.csv, soc2-sig-qa-answers.docx). A couple of final operational notes:

- We confirm weekly authenticated scans in production with daily public-surface sweeps.
- Our committed SLA targets below will be included in the audit packet; exceptions are tracked and visible in the closure CSV.

Committed SLA targets (final):
• Critical: triage within 48 hours; remediation target 14 days (hotpatching/rollback plan executed as required).
• High: triage within 72 hours; remediation target 30 days.
• Medium: triage within 7 business days; remediation target 90 days.

Doc & access notes: the Drive link to the proofpack (read-only) is: https://drive.google.com/redwood/proofpack/acmecorp
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/98765

If the auditor needs a signed attestation on letterhead, we can produce that within 48 hours — let me know and I'll route it to legal. Happy to schedule the 20-min walkthrough; propose Thursday 2028-09-07 10:00-10:20 PT if that works for your team.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive — Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
